import math

n = int(input())
best_a = 1
best_b = n
min_diff = n - 1

for a in range(1, int(math.isqrt(n)) + 1):
    if n % a == 0:
        b = n // a
        if a <= b:
            diff = b - a
            if diff < min_diff:
                min_diff = diff
                best_a = a
                best_b = b

print(best_a, best_b)
